info.title: Zeptly Social API
info.description: Provider-neutral social infrastructure gateway for Zeptly. All objects are canonical Zeptly Social objects; provider identifiers never appear. Authenticated with ZS1-HMAC-SHA256 service signatures (see docs/SECURITY.md).

zeptlyServiceSignature.name: X-Zeptly-Signature
zeptlyServiceSignature.description: ZS1-HMAC-SHA256 signature. Also requires X-Zeptly-Caller, X-Zeptly-Timestamp and (workspace routes) X-Zeptly-Workspace-Id. See docs/SECURITY.md.

SocialCapabilitiesInput.description: Capabilities this service exposes for a network. A false flag means the operation is rejected with CAPABILITY_NOT_SUPPORTED.

video.description: Absent when video is not supported

post.summary: Initiate provisioning of a social account
post.description: oauth_redirect / provider_managed: returns a provisioning session with `authorizationUrl`; send the end user's browser there. The provider redirects back through this service, which returns the browser to `returnUrl?provisioningId=…&status=…`. credentials (Bluesky): pass `credentials`; the connection is created synchronously.

parameters.name: idempotency-key
parameters.description: REQUIRED (missing → 400 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REQUIRED). 8-128 chars [A-Za-z0-9._:-]. Replays return the original response; reuse with a different body → IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.
